summary: Fourteen days of Nightscout closed-loop data show strong overall time in range with a binding hypoglycemia pattern after afternoon rises and overnight, while scheduled profile insulin is largely untestable because meals were unannounced and Dynamic ISF plus always-on UAM/SMB delivered most extra insulin. The selected AAPS profile is complete and historically declared applicable; no isolated fasting, carb, or single-setting experiment supports a profile or automation value change in this file.

analysis_steps.findings: CGM coverage is good at 98.7 percent with a 5-minute cadence, 10 gaps, and a largest gap of 65 minutes. The selected aaps_profile is complete. Carb treatments are zero and sampled loop COB is 0. A profile switch to the current named 16.2 U/day flat-ISF profile occurred on 13 Aug, with site, sensor, occlusion, GLP-1, and restart events also present.
analysis_steps.evidence: telemetry.data_quality status good; 3995 valid entries; treatment_summary carb_entries 0 and total_carbs_g 0; carb_treatment_entries empty; representative_events profile switch, site/sensor changes, occlusion, GLP-1 notes; profile_context historical_applicability yes.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: No activity log, no fasting flags, no pre-13 Aug profile dump, and no independent confirmation of how u200 dilution is entered in AAPS.

analysis_steps.findings: Mean glucose 121.6 mg/dL, TIR 86.0 percent, TAR 8.9 percent, TBR 5.1 percent, CV 32.6 percent. Local TBR is concentrated at 01:00 (18.5 percent) and 19:00 (15.3 percent), with extremes of 41-42 mg/dL. Afternoon TAR peaks at 16:00. Overnight target 90, DIA 10 h, always-on SMB, Dynamic ISF, and very high unused max IOB/basal are safety constraints on later changes.
analysis_steps.evidence: glucose_summary; hourly_glucose_local; glucose_extremes; daily TIR/TBR on 14 and 18 Aug; therapy_response_windows with large post-insulin drops; smb_settings max_iob 25 U and max_basal 12 U/h.
analysis_steps.dependencies: data_quality supports pattern location; missing carbs and activity limit cause attribution.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: No hypo-treatment markers and no exercise record; Dynamic ISF changes effective ISF continuously.

analysis_steps.findings: 05:00-08:00 local is the most fasting-like stable block and does not implicate the 06:00 0.8 U/h segment. 00:00-03:00 sits near target 90 with high TBR and is not a clean basal test. Afternoon highs occur while 16:00 basal is already the lowest scheduled rate. Daytime target 100 is below afternoon means but is confounded by unlogged intake and SMB.
analysis_steps.evidence: basal_segments 0.6/0.7/0.8/0.7/0.5/0.6/0.7 U/h; target_segments 90/100/90 mg/dL; hourly_glucose_local overnight TBR versus 05:00-08:00 TIR 97-99 percent; 16:00 local TAR 32.1 percent.
analysis_steps.dependencies: safety_overview TBR constraint; meal and IOB effects not yet separated.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: No classified fasting nights and enacted temps/SMB dominate over scheduled basal.

analysis_steps.findings: CR segments exist but had no carb entries to act on, so they are unused rather than proven wrong. Profile ISF is flat 56 mg/dL/U while loop variable_sens ranged about 28-124 under Dynamic ISF. DIA 10 h is compatible with afternoon insulin still acting at 19:00 and overnight. Correction windows are not isolatable ISF tests.
analysis_steps.evidence: carb_ratio_segments 13/11.1/13.2/10.5/12.6 g/U; isf_segments 56; dia_hours 10; therapy_response_windows all Correction Bolus; representative_loop_statuses variable_sens and COB 0.
analysis_steps.dependencies: basal_targets did not assign daytime highs to scheduled basal; safety_overview limits any stronger insulin setting.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: No meal-linked carb/bolus pairs and no Dynamic-ISF-off contrast.

analysis_steps.findings: Always-on SMB plus UAM with unused COB switches matches unannounced-meal execution. The loop adds insulin during afternoon rises and later sets rate 0 when minGuardBG is low, so lows are more consistent with insulin already delivered than with SMB firing through a low. Interval 3 min and UAM 20 min versus SMB 15 min are aggressive relative to DIA 10 h but not singly identifiable. High temporary targets of 135 with high-TT SMB disabled were used protectively.
analysis_steps.evidence: smb_enabled true; uam_enabled true; smb_always_enabled true; smb_with_cob_enabled false; sampled reasons UAM Boost and microboluses; high TT events; 19:00 local TBR after 14:00-17:00 TAR.
analysis_steps.dependencies: safety_overview; basal_targets; profile_cr_isf_dia. Meal logging still unknown at this stage.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Only 24 loop snapshots; SMB cadence versus temp-basal contribution is not fully counted.

analysis_steps.findings: Autosens is off and Dynamic ISF at 70 percent is the effective ISF. Max basal 12 U/h and max IOB 25 U never bound; observed IOB reached about 6 U and temps about 4 U/h, with one reason clipped to maxSafeBasal 4. Carb-absorption settings had no COB to act on. Automation is compensating for missing meal announcements and a flat profile ISF more than for a specific basal or CR defect.
analysis_steps.evidence: autosens_enabled false; dynamic_sensitivity_enabled true; dynamic_isf_adjustment_factor_percent 70; max_basal_u_per_hour 12; max_iob_units 25; loop IOB 4.73-5.94 U; min_5m_carbimpact 8 unused.
analysis_steps.dependencies: SMB/UAM catch-up and safety TBR; profile ISF 56 is only a baseline while Dynamic ISF is on.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: No binding event on the inventory caps and no Autosens-on comparison.

analysis_steps.findings: User-declared meal_strategies is an empty list and strategy_stable_for_period is null, so there is no declared prebolus_minutes or immediate_bolus_percent to reproduce. Telemetry likewise shows no meal boluses, only correction and SMB/UAM insulin after rises. Clock-time waves at 08:00-10:00 and 14:00-17:00 are meal-shaped but not composition-proven.
analysis_steps.evidence: aaps_profile.analysis_context meal_strategies empty; treatment_summary insulin_entries 655 with carb_entries 0; therapy_response_windows event_type Correction Bolus; hourly_glucose_local meal-shaped rises.
analysis_steps.dependencies: CR unused; SMB/UAM and Dynamic ISF already explain catch-up; DIA and target 90 explain the hypo tail.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Meal start clock time and a yes/no afternoon intake record are absent.

analysis_steps.findings: No declared e-carb amount, offset, or duration and no extended carb entries. E-carbs were not used and must not be inferred from temp basal or SMB. Carb-absorption model settings were idle.
analysis_steps.evidence: extended_carb_entries 0; average_extended_carb_duration_min null; carb_treatment_entries empty; sampled COB 0.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: No meal-linked absorption curve; one lunch/afternoon intake log would help more than any e-carb parameter review.

analysis_steps.findings: Ranked explanations are (1) unannounced intake plus always-on UAM/SMB and Dynamic ISF causing afternoon highs then evening crash, (2) residual IOB with DIA 10 h and overnight target 90 causing 00:00-03:00 TBR, (3) possible mild overnight basal or target pressure that is not separated, and (4) GLP-1, occlusion, and the 13 Aug profile switch as modifiers. CR, e-carbs, 16:00 basal 0.5 U/h, and 06:00 basal 0.8 U/h are not supported defects. All inventory values are kept because competing dependencies are unresolved. Safe order is classify meals and overnight IOB first, keep profile, keep automation, and only later consider a single announced-meal experiment.
analysis_steps.evidence: Combined glucose_summary, hourly_glucose_local, zero carbs, loop UAM/Dynamic ISF samples, unused CR, non-binding 12 U/h and 25 U caps, and empty declared meal_strategies.
analysis_steps.dependencies: All prior stages. Package values override any earlier wording that treated the first six days as a different unknown profile; applicability is declared yes, with the 13 Aug switch retained only as uncertainty.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: A few days of afternoon meal-start times, or an explicit never-announce confirmation, plus 22:00-01:00 IOB notes.

strengths: CGM coverage 98.7 percent is adequate for clock-time pattern review.
Overall TIR 86.0 percent with mean glucose 121.6 mg/dL.
05:00-08:00 local control is stable and does not show a dawn basal failure.
The loop often sets temp rate 0 when predicted guard glucose is low.
High temporary targets of 135 were used with high-TT SMB disabled.
Scheduled basal totals about 16.2 U/day and matches the selected profile name.
issues: TBR 5.1 percent with clustered local lows at 01:00 and 19:00, including 41-42 mg/dL extremes.
Afternoon local TAR peaks at 14:00-17:00 then falls into an evening crash, consistent with late UAM/SMB rather than a single basal segment.
No announced carbs, so CR, prebolus, immediate bolus percent, and e-carbs cannot be tested.
Overnight target 90 sits on a trough whose cause is still mixed residual IOB versus scheduled basal.
Max IOB 25 U and max basal 12 U/h are far above observed TDD and never limited catch-up stacks of about 5-6 U IOB.
Occlusion on 19 Aug and a 13 Aug profile switch add day-level noise.

recommendations.title: Keep overnight basal and target; classify evening IOB first
recommendations.description: 00:00-03:00 local TBR is real but not a clean basal defect. Afternoon unannounced UAM/SMB and DIA 10 h remain competing causes, so the 00:00 0.6 U/h basal and 90 mg/dL overnight target stay unchanged until those nights are classified.

suggested_change.review_direction: no overnight insulin increase or decrease until 22:00-01:00 IOB and afternoon intake are noted

recommendations.title: Hold SMB, UAM, and Dynamic ISF until that overnight check
recommendations.description: Always-on UAM/SMB and Dynamic ISF already explain daytime catch-up. Changing interval, UAM minutes, Dynamic ISF, or max IOB in the same step as basal or target would mix dependent settings.

suggested_change.review_direction: review automation only after meal-start and overnight IOB notes, and only one group at a time

profile_recommendation.recommendation: Keep every current basal, target, CR, ISF, and DIA value. First verify whether 00:00-03:00 local lows follow afternoon unannounced UAM rather than excess 00:00 0.6 U/h basal.
profile_recommendation.rationale: The only fasting-like window, 05:00-08:00 local, is stable. Overnight TBR overlaps target 90 and leftover afternoon IOB. Daytime highs occur while 16:00 basal is already the lowest rate and CR is unused. No profile row has an isolated supporting experiment.
profile_recommendation.next_check: On several nights record 22:00-01:00 local IOB and whether afternoon or evening intake occurred, then compare 00:00-03:00 local TBR before revisiting 00:00 basal 0.6 U/h or overnight target 90 mg/dL.

parameter_decisions.rationale: Evidence: 00:00-03:00 local TBR is high while mean glucose is near 90 mg/dL. Uncertainty: residual evening IOB, DIA 10 h, and target 90 are not separated. Dependencies: do not change this with SMB, Dynamic ISF, or overnight target.

Evidence: 05:00 local TIR is high and average glucose is near 104 mg/dL. Uncertainty: one 42 mg/dL reading on 21 Aug after a sensor change. Dependencies: overnight TBR attribution is still unresolved.
Evidence: 06:00-08:00 local TIR 98-99 percent with averages about 100-110 mg/dL. Uncertainty: not a formally flagged fasting test. Dependencies: later morning rise is meal-confounded.
Evidence: late-morning and midday TAR coincide with unannounced-meal-shaped rises and UAM/SMB. Uncertainty: no carb timestamps. Dependencies: CR unused; automation already adding insulin.

Evidence: 16:00 is already the lowest basal during the highest local TAR, so this cut is not the afternoon-high cause. Uncertainty: evening crash may still include leftover UAM IOB. Dependencies: do not raise this basal while 19:00 TBR is unexplained.

Evidence: 18:00-19:00 local glucose falls and 19:00 TBR is 15.3 percent after afternoon catch-up. Uncertainty: mixed IOB, possible activity, and GLP-1. Dependencies: SMB/UAM and DIA remain competing explanations.
Evidence: evening recovery is mixed with continued TBR risk into 23:00. Uncertainty: late intake versus leftover IOB. Dependencies: overnight target 90 and DIA 10 h.
Evidence: zero carb entries and COB 0, so this segment did not run. Uncertainty: night intake cannot be excluded. Dependencies: meal announcement must exist before any CR review.
Evidence: unused in this file. Uncertainty: breakfast-shaped rise starts later and is unlogged. Dependencies: CR changes are not identifiable while UAM is the prandial method.
Evidence: 08:00-10:00 local rise occurred with no announced carbs. Uncertainty: composition unknown. Dependencies: SMB/UAM and Dynamic ISF already acted on the rise.

Evidence: the tightest CR is idle without carb entries and cannot explain 16:00 TAR. Uncertainty: if carbs were eaten but not entered, UAM still delivered the insulin. Dependencies: do not tighten CR while 19:00 TBR is high.
Evidence: unused. Uncertainty: late meals not documented. Dependencies: evening hypo risk precedes any stronger meal insulin.

Evidence: Dynamic ISF made effective sensitivity about 28-124, so 56 is only a baseline. Uncertainty: correction windows include UAM, IOB, and possible GLP-1. Dependencies: changing ISF while Dynamic ISF stays on is not separable.

Evidence: overnight mean sits on 90 with high TBR, but this may be leftover IOB rather than the target alone. Uncertainty: no fasting overnight classification. Dependencies: do not change together with 00:00 basal or SMB.
Evidence: daytime means exceed 100 mainly in meal-shaped hours. Uncertainty: target 100 may invite SMB during unlogged rises, but that is not isolated. Dependencies: SMB always-on and Dynamic ISF.

Evidence: 23:00 local TBR about 10 percent continues the overnight trough pattern. Uncertainty: same IOB versus target conflict as 00:00. Dependencies: keep paired with overnight basal until classified.

Evidence: long DIA is a plausible reason afternoon catch-up is still active at 19:00 and overnight. Uncertainty: no DIA experiment. Dependencies: shortening DIA while SMB remains aggressive could hide IOB.

Evidence: this pair is the observed prandial method with COB 0. Uncertainty: turning UAM off is untested and could raise afternoon TAR. Dependencies: meal announcement status unknown; do not pair with CR or basal changes. No source component is null so verify is not used.

Evidence: always-on SMB with unused COB flags matches zero carbs; high-TT SMB lockout was used at 135. Uncertainty: smb_always_enabled is also the catch-up path into evening lows. Dependencies: keep until meal-start notes exist. No null components.

Dependencies: do not change with max IOB or overnight basal. Remaining temp minutes in reasons are not this interval.

parameter_decisions.parameter: AAPS max basal and max IOB
parameter_decisions.rationale: Evidence: 12 U/h and 25 U never bound; observed stacks reached about 4 U/h and 6 U IOB on a roughly 20 U TDD. Uncertainty: lowering unused caps is a safety-policy choice without a binding event in this file. Dependencies: not the initiating cause versus SMB plus Dynamic ISF.

Evidence: Autosens off is consistent with unused Autosens target shifts; Dynamic ISF 70 percent is the acting ISF. A sensitivity_ratio of 1 is a neutral current adjustment, not disabled Autosens. Uncertainty: no Dynamic-ISF-off contrast. Dependencies: do not change with profile ISF 56.
Evidence: both values were idle with COB 0. Uncertainty: they cannot be judged until carbs or e-carbs are entered. Dependencies: meal strategy, not basal or ISF.

meal_strategy_summary.suggestion: The period ran as unannounced meals: no declared or observed prebolus, no immediate meal-bolus percent, no e-carbs, and always-on UAM/SMB after glucose rose. Keep that description and do not tune CR or e-carb duration from this file; any later announced-meal test should be a single logging or small prebolus experiment, not a combined CR plus SMB plus e-carb change.
meal_strategy_summary.rationale: Declared meal_strategies is empty and Nightscout shows zero carbs with COB 0, so declared strategy and observed execution agree that this was not a CR-driven meal program. Afternoon TAR then 19:00 TBR matches late UAM catch-up plus DIA 10 h.
meal_strategy_summary.next_observation: Record meal start clock time and a yes/no plus rough grams for lunch or afternoon intake for several days, or confirm never-announce by design.

exceptions.suggestion: Do not add more catch-up insulin or a tighter 16:00 CR first; this is the highest hypo-cost unannounced-meal wave.
exceptions.rationale: Local TAR peaks at 16:00 and 19:00 TBR is 15.3 percent after UAM/SMB and corrections.

exceptions.suggestion: Treat those intervals as a different, SMB-suppressed pattern and do not average them into CR or ISF conclusions.
exceptions.rationale: High-TT SMB is disabled and 135 targets were used on multiple afternoons.

implementation_steps: Treat this output as decision-support for review only and independently verify every value against the pump and AAPS screens.
Keep the current profile. First collect afternoon meal-start notes and 22:00-01:00 local IOB for several days.
Reassess 00:00-03:00 and 19:00 local TBR only after those notes exist; do not move overnight basal and overnight target together.
Leave SMB, UAM, Dynamic ISF, max IOB, and max basal unchanged while that check is running.
If a later single experiment is discussed, choose either meal announcement or one automation group, not both, and monitor glucose closely after any one change.
education: UAM doses unexplained rises and is not the same as counting COB twice.
Dynamic ISF can make the effective ISF much stronger or weaker than the flat 56 mg/dL/U profile value.
A sensitivity_ratio of 1 means a neutral current adjustment, not that Autosens is enabled.
E-carbs are not a pump extended bolus and none were present to interpret.
Overnight lows after afternoon catch-up can reflect insulin already on board even when the loop later sets a zero temp.
safety_notes: This is decision-support content only and is not medical advice.
The user must independently verify every proposed change, make changes one at a time, and monitor glucose closely.
TBR 5.1 percent with 41-42 mg/dL lows is the binding constraint; do not strengthen overnight or evening insulin first.
The profile is labeled u200 dilute and GLP-1 1.25 mg notes appear; unit scale and sensitivity shifts need human confirmation.
Max IOB 25 U and max basal 12 U/h did not bind and can allow large stacks relative to an approximately 20 U daily total.
Do not change AAPS automatically from this analysis.
